ignoreCommand: [ "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" = "main" ] || exit 0; [ -n "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" ] || exit 1; git cat-file -e "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || git fetch -q --depth=1 origin "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" 2>/dev/null || exit 1; git diff --quiet "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" HEAD -- . 2>/dev/null && exit 0; exit 1
